mfa_factors_totp_has_secret.name: mfa_factors_totp_has_secret
mfa_factors_totp_has_secret.value: "mfa_factors"."type" <> 'totp' OR ("mfa_factors"."totp_secret" IS NOT NULL AND "mfa_factors"."webauthn_credential_id" IS NULL)

mfa_factors_webauthn_has_credential.name: mfa_factors_webauthn_has_credential
mfa_factors_webauthn_has_credential.value: "mfa_factors"."type" <> 'webauthn' OR ("mfa_factors"."webauthn_credential_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mfa_factors"."webauthn_public_key" IS NOT NULL AND "mfa_factors"."webauthn_counter" IS NOT NULL AND "mfa_factors"."totp_secret" IS NULL)

report_actions_actor_valid.name: report_actions_actor_valid
report_actions_actor_valid.value:
("report_actions"."actor_type" = 'system' and "report_actions"."actor_id" is null)
        or ("report_actions"."actor_type" = 'user' and "report_actions"."actor_id" ~ '^usr_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$')
        or ("report_actions"."actor_type" = 'api_key' and "report_actions"."actor_id" ~ '^key_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$')

reports_due_idx.name: reports_due_idx
reports_due_idx.where: "reports"."next_run_at" is not null and "reports"."paused_at" is null and "reports"."redacted_at" is null

network_syncs_superseded_snapshot_idx.name: network_syncs_superseded_snapshot_idx
network_syncs_superseded_snapshot_idx.where: "network_syncs"."outcome" = 'applied' and "network_syncs"."snapshot_deleted_at" is null and "network_syncs"."superseded_at" is not null

devices_identifiers_fit_platform.name: devices_identifiers_fit_platform
devices_identifiers_fit_platform.value:
("devices"."platform" <> 'web' or "devices"."device_fingerprint" is null)
        and ("devices"."platform" <> 'android'
             or ("devices"."browser_fingerprint" is null and "devices"."device_class" is null))

handoff_tokens_declined_revokes.name: handoff_tokens_declined_revokes
handoff_tokens_declined_revokes.value: "handoff_tokens"."declined_at" is null or "handoff_tokens"."revoked_at" is not null

importers_counts_non_negative.name: importers_counts_non_negative
importers_counts_non_negative.value:
"importers"."row_count" >= 0 and "importers"."successful_count" >= 0 and "importers"."duplicate_count" >= 0
        and "importers"."already_present_count" >= 0 and "importers"."error_count" >= 0
        and "importers"."attempts" >= 0 and "importers"."file_bytes" >= 0

list_item_backgrounds_layout_complete.name: list_item_backgrounds_layout_complete
list_item_backgrounds_layout_complete.value:
("list_item_backgrounds"."layout" is null) = ("list_item_backgrounds"."valid_cells" is null)
        and ("list_item_backgrounds"."layout" is null) = ("list_item_backgrounds"."coverage" is null)

list_items_environment_id_country_code_i.name: list_items_environment_id_country_code_idx
list_items_environment_id_country_code_i.where: "list_items"."country_code" is not null and "list_items"."archived_at" is null

list_items_redacted_holds_nothing.name: list_items_redacted_holds_nothing
list_items_redacted_holds_nothing.value:
"list_items"."redacted_at" is null
        or ("list_items"."value" is null and "list_items"."match_key" is null
            and "list_items"."country_code" is null)

list_matches_redacted_holds_nothing.name: list_matches_redacted_holds_nothing
list_matches_redacted_holds_nothing.value:
"list_matches"."redacted_at" is null
        or ("list_matches"."matched_value" is null and "list_matches"."reason" is null)

lists_biometric_retention.name: lists_biometric_retention
lists_biometric_retention.value: not "lists"."type" in ('face', 'selfie-background') or "lists"."item_retention_days" is not null

transaction_files_undeleted_redacted_idx.name: transaction_files_undeleted_redacted_idx
transaction_files_undeleted_redacted_idx.where: "transaction_files"."redacted_at" is not null and "transaction_files"."deleted_at" is null

transaction_files_filename_until_redacte.name: transaction_files_filename_until_redacted
transaction_files_filename_until_redacte.value: "transaction_files"."filename" is not null or "transaction_files"."redacted_at" is not null

transaction_labels_label_until_redacted.name: transaction_labels_label_until_redacted
transaction_labels_label_until_redacted.value: "transaction_labels"."label" is not null or "transaction_labels"."redacted_at" is not null

transaction_status_history_status_until_.name: transaction_status_history_status_until_redacted
transaction_status_history_status_until_.value: "transaction_status_history"."to_status" is not null or "transaction_status_history"."redacted_at" is not null

transaction_status_history_actor_valid.name: transaction_status_history_actor_valid
transaction_status_history_actor_valid.value:
("transaction_status_history"."actor_type" = 'system' and "transaction_status_history"."actor_id" is null)
        or ("transaction_status_history"."actor_type" = 'user' and "transaction_status_history"."actor_id" ~ '^usr_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$')
        or ("transaction_status_history"."actor_type" = 'api_key' and "transaction_status_history"."actor_id" ~ '^key_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$')

transactions_fields_until_redacted.name: transactions_fields_until_redacted
transactions_fields_until_redacted.value: "transactions"."fields" is not null or "transactions"."redacted_at" is not null

graph_attributes_source_id_format.name: graph_attributes_source_id_format
graph_attributes_source_id_format.value: ("graph_attributes"."source_type" = 'account' and "graph_attributes"."source_id" ~ '^acc_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$') or ("graph_attributes"."source_type" = 'inquiry' and "graph_attributes"."source_id" ~ '^inq_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$') or ("graph_attributes"."source_type" = 'inquiry-session' and "graph_attributes"."source_id" ~ '^iqse_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$') or ("graph_attributes"."source_type" = 'verification' and "graph_attributes"."source_id" ~ '^ver_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$')

graph_queries_params_until_redacted.name: graph_queries_params_until_redacted
graph_queries_params_until_redacted.value: "graph_queries"."redacted_at" is not null or "graph_queries"."params" is not null

graph_queries_redacted_empty.name: graph_queries_redacted_empty
graph_queries_redacted_empty.value:
"graph_queries"."redacted_at" is null or ("graph_queries"."params" is null
        and "graph_queries"."nodes" = '[]'::jsonb and "graph_queries"."links" = '[]'::jsonb
        and "graph_queries"."node_map" = '{}'::jsonb and cardinality("graph_queries"."account_ids") = 0)
